denominators.cache: distributed RAM/disk/peer cache absent; generic object-store adapter cache occupancy separately observed across all adapters; gauges retained; unknown occupancy stays incomplete
denominators.comparison: historical runs are unpaired; different dates, source and cache/state history; no isolated causal attribution; D20 changes geometry
denominators.counters: before_active to after_active process-local observations; boundary observers/background included; not a global atomic cut
denominators.cpu: process CPU divided by its own monotonic observation interval; observers/background included; excludes backend and collector processes
denominators.http: partial observed RustFS service dispatch/body work by mixed data/probe role and method; offered bytes are not uploads/commits; body bytes precede validation/retries; header success is not EOF/durability; durations overlap
denominators.latency: 32 log2 microsecond buckets; percentile bounds only; final bucket censored; RPC sub-1us values land in bucket1; no complete-cycle latency histogram
denominators.logical_payload: 4 KiB active read comparisons and read/write preparation; excludes truncation bytes and untimed setup/oracles
denominators.physical_io: RustFS guest cgroup whole-run accounting includes setup/oracles/background/writeback; no contemporaneous TiKV or host physical flash IOPS
denominators.pool: pool checkout await includes possible lazy connection/session setup; queue-only wait unavailable
denominators.production: local loopback depth-one native clients; 10 or20 Drives is not 10000-client production, OS mounting or cross-host/OIDC qualification
denominators.quic: worker active-boundary UDP payload counters exclude headers; client retained boundary also includes idle liveness; frames/datagrams/API calls differ
denominators.rss: nullable endpoints and process lifetime peaks; no per-cell or simultaneous fleet peak; allocation profiling disabled
denominators.sql: classified client submissions; successful known-count SELECT returned rows only; no affected/scanned rows, server execution or TiKV attribution
denominators.throughput: all active clients together; complete cycles and acknowledged RPCs divided by drained active workload duration; open/close included in RPCs

rustfs_guest_cgroup.scope: new RustFS container guest cgroup; whole native benchmark window includes setup, oracle, background and writeback; not physical IOPS or TiKV
